# Alpine Fence & Deck

> Utah's premier fence and deck builder — now with full yard & landscape services. Wood, vinyl, Sim/Tek, composite, ornamental iron, aluminum, ranch rail, decking, and railing systems — plus staining, refinishing, repair, sod installation, retaining walls, paver patios, sprinklers, and landscape design across 94 cities on the Wasatch Front. Founded 2009. Provo, Utah.

## Company Overview

Alpine Fence and Deck is a licensed and insured fence, deck, and landscape contractor based in Provo, Utah. We install every major fencing and decking material, offer professional staining, refinishing, and repair, and now provide a full Yard & Landscape service line across 94 cities in Utah (Weber, Davis, Salt Lake, Utah, Tooele, Wasatch, Summit, and Cache counties).

## Fence & Deck Services

- **Wood Fence Installation**: Privacy, picket, ranch rail and custom cedar/pine designs. $3,000–$15,000.
- **Composite Fence Installation**: Premium composite fencing including Compoxen® certified installs with 25-year material warranty. $8,000–$45,000.
- **Vinyl & Sim/Tek Fence Installation**: Lifetime-color vinyl and engineered Sim/Tek privacy systems.
- **Iron & Aluminum Fence Installation**: Ornamental iron and rust-free aluminum, including pool-safe designs.
- **Decking & Railings**: Custom decks, iron railings, and vinyl railings.
- **Fence & Deck Staining**: Premium oil and water-based stains with full surface prep. $600–$3,000.
- **Deck & Fence Refinishing**: Sanding, staining, and sealing for existing wood. $800–$3,500.
- **Fence & Deck Repair**: Board replacement, post resetting, gate alignment, storm damage. $200–$2,500.

## Yard & Landscape Services (New 2026)

- **Sod & Lawn Installation**: Site grading, soil prep, premium Utah-climate sod. $1,500–$8,000.
- **Retaining Walls & Hardscapes**: Engineered block, boulder, and timber walls. $3,500–$25,000.
- **Paver Patios & Walkways**: Custom pavers on engineered base, integrated with deck/fence. $3,000–$20,000.
- **Sprinkler & Irrigation Install & Repair**: New systems, smart controllers, drip lines, repairs. $200–$6,000.
- **Landscape Design & Grading**: Full-property design, drainage, and site grading. $500–$5,000 design.
